fact: Gabon Media Time reports that the Ministry of National Education has begun integrating school health and well-being indicators (hygiene, nutrition, water access, safety) into its Education Management Information System (SIGE).
system: Système d'Information pour la Gestion de l'Éducation (SIGE)

fact: SOSUP launched a national operation to identify schools and assign each learner a unique national identifier (INA), collecting school and pupil files through provincial and zonal academic delegates to centralise school data, per Le Journal des Lycées.
system: Opération Nationale d'Identification des Établissements et des Apprenants (INA)
